system.description:
Dense streets and tall buildings, always surrounded by people. Markets never close, and a person is never alone, even in a quiet hour. People learn to read a crowd, hold their ground, and move fast.

Talent: one Finesse die to d10, one Presence die to d10.

  • Crowd Wise. +2 Training in Assertiveness.
  • Hurried Step. +2 to Initiative rolls.
